description: RE-D125 / Controller N1 native Neo settings; the copied Node schema remains unchanged.

maxRecords.description: Emergency append ceiling; archive before truncation. Native acquisition supports at most 50000 rows.

appendDedupeTailRecords.description: Replay-deduplication tail, independent of maxRecords; persistent identity indexes remain authoritative.

retention.description: Scheduled maintenance only (RY-A/N2); no retention in the append path.

days.description: Minimum age in days for scheduled retention; append never uses this age to remove records.

softMaxRecords.description: Scheduled retention considers old, unprotected records only above this live-record count.
